title: FireCortex Setup Wizard
subtitle: Safely persist your database and cache for a fast, self-contained single-binary deployment
alreadyInitialized: FireCortex is already initialized. Redirecting to sign in...

unlock.title: Enter One-Time Setup Token
unlock.description: To prevent unauthorized initialization on public networks, copy the one-time Setup Token printed in your terminal, journalctl -u firecortex logs, or the .setup-token file.

environment.title: Host Environment Check & Registry Mirror
environment.description: Verify Docker Engine connectivity, default loopback port availability, and host disk space.
environment.dockerUnavailableHint: To let FireCortex manage PostgreSQL and Redis via Docker, ensure Docker is running and accessible by the service user. You can also continue with an external database.
environment.dockerHostHint: Defaults to unix:///var/run/docker.sock. Supports Rootless Docker or custom socket proxy URLs.
environment.mirrorPlaceholder: e.g. docker.m.daocloud.io (leave blank for direct pull)
environment.mirrorHint: Rewrites image pulls through your mirror prefix and persists it in docker-compose.yml.

database.title: Database & Cache Configuration
database.description: Managed Docker mode automatically provisions PostgreSQL + pgvector and Redis with loopback-only ports, strong random passwords, and an auto-synced docker-compose.yml.
database.modeManagedDesc: Loopback-only ports (127.0.0.1), random 0600 credentials, protected bind mounts, and automatic self-healing.
database.modeExternalDesc: Use managed cloud Postgres (RDS / Neon / Supabase) or your own PostgreSQL + pgvector instance.
database.dataDirLabel: Managed Data Root Directory (Host Absolute Path)
database.dirEmpty: Empty directory — safe for fresh initialization
database.adoptTitle: Enable Safe Adoption Mode (preserve existing data, never overwrite)
database.adoptDesc: Use when migrating servers or reinstalling over an existing pgdata directory.
database.existingCredentialsHint: Leave blank to auto-read credentials from an existing .env in this directory, or enter your existing database credentials.
database.originalKey: Original data encryption key (when restoring an existing FireCortex database)
database.cacheManagedRedis: Managed Redis container (default, password + AOF persistence)
database.cacheMemory: In-process memory cache (no Redis container, lightweight single node)
database.advancedToggle: Advanced Options (ports, images, memory limits, path overrides, compose sync)
database.pgVectorMissing: pgvector extension not detected; vector search will be limited

site.title: Site URL & Initial Superadmin
site.description: Configure your public origin and first superadmin account. When adopting a database that already has an admin, you may leave credentials blank.
site.envProd: prod (Production — requires https:// URL and strict security validation)
site.envDev: dev (LAN / HTTP testing — allows non-HTTPS access)
site.corsLabel: CORS Allowed Origin (defaults to Public URL)
site.adoptAdminHint: Safe adoption mode is enabled: existing administrator accounts will be preserved automatically.

progress.title: Initializing FireCortex
progress.subtitle: Pulling images, persisting configuration and compose files — please keep this page open...
progress.doneDesc: FireCortex wrote config.json and docker-compose.yml and triggered an in-place restart. Waiting for the server to come online...
progress.waitingReady: Waiting for FireCortex server to become ready...
